content:
With Apple's most important product event of the year — the September iPhone launch — now just one month away, here's what new products are expected to be unveiled based on the various rumours.

iPhone 18 Pro, Pro Max, and iPhone Ultra

This year's flagship iPhone lineup is reportedly set to be the smallest in years — and also the most expensive.

The reason is that all signs point to the standard iPhone 18 not arriving until early 2027, with the iPhone Air 2 also likely to be delayed alongside it.

So three new iPhone models are expected to debut next month:

  • iPhone 18 Pro: major camera upgrades, new colours, a smaller Dynamic Island, and more
  • iPhone 18 Pro Max: all of the above upgrades, plus a larger battery
  • iPhone Ultra: a brand-new form factor and the first-ever foldable iPhone

Analysts estimate the iPhone 18 Pro will start at around $1,399, while the iPhone Ultra is expected to come in at around $1,999. Here's hoping Apple can deliver pricing lower than expected.

Apple Watch Ultra 4 and Series 12

New Apple Watch models launch every September, and this year is expected to be no different.

Here are the two new Apple Watch models rumoured:

  • Apple Watch Ultra 4: new health sensors, refreshed design, and more
  • Apple Watch Series 12: more powerful SiP processor, all-new health features

Details on these two new watches remain scarce so far. That could mean this year's changes are modest — or it could simply mean Apple is holding back plenty of surprises.

Wild cards: new AirPods Pro, Apple home products

iPhones and Apple Watches are almost certain to appear at the September event, but Apple may also use the occasion to launch other products.

The most likely candidates are new AirPods and Apple home products.

  • AirPods Pro with cameras: cameras to power AI features, with potential health or accessibility functions
  • New Apple TV 4K: more powerful chip to support Apple Intelligence and Siri AI
  • HomePad / HomePod Touch: a screen-equipped HomePod centred around Siri
  • HomePod mini 2: Siri AI, new chip, improved sound
  • HomePod 3: Siri AI and a new chip, with otherwise fairly limited changes
  • Apple security camera: a home surveillance camera supporting HomeKit Secure Video

Apple has plenty of other fall products that could also appear next month, such as a new OLED iPad mini, new MacBook Pros, and Ultra models. However, these are generally expected to be pushed back to October.

Which Apple product from the September event are you planning to pick up? Share your thoughts in the comments.
